title: Constructibility of integral scalar residue layer
statement: The residue-layer tensor has constructible homology in every degree under the source residue constructibility hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma lemma-tensor-product-locally-constant; lemma-constructible-serre; parent residue-layer argument.

proof.text: The recorded DVR witness identifies the source and target exponent-one ideals with their maximal ideals. Give these two finite quotients their quotient-field structures. On fixed-module sheaves, restriction of scalars preserves finite local constancy by pullback/restriction commutation and constantCommuteCompose: restrict the same finite constant module on each cover. Apply this to each stratum. Naturality of the constant-section unit identifies ringed-module restriction with fixed-module restriction. The existing constructibility encoding equivalences give constructibility preservation for coefficient module sheaves. The pullback/restriction isomorphism is constructed directly as the conjugate of the identity commuting coextension with direct image, using the restriction/coextension adjunction; no projection-formula import is needed.

Compute source residue reduction on the given K-flat representative using integralDerivedReductionKFlatIso. Compose the localization homology comparison and the existing fixed/coefficient constructibility equivalences. The source hypothesis h1 then makes every ordinary source residue homology sheaf constructible. Prove exactness of finite-field scalar extension by transporting sheafified objectwise tensor through the constant-module encoding equivalences: a field map is flat. Use the existing local tensor model lemma and finiteness of scalar extension of a finite module to preserve constructibility with the same strata and covers. Exactness gives commutation with homology. Exact target restriction commutes with homology, and the directly proved restriction result preserves the finite models. The interval and support assumptions are not required for this clause.

Substitute the specified power filtration using hF. Apply the derived tensor comparison to P.obj and j, then take the derived homology functor and compose with homologyFunctorFactors on both sides. Transport the constructibility just proved for the restricted scalar-extension complex through this homology isomorphism.

proof_origin.description: D6: prove finite-model restriction, K-flat source computation, exact finite-field scalar-extension homology and constructibility transport. Isolate only the coefficient/tensor derived isomorphism, with no constructibility, bounds or K-flat hypothesis, as a genuine comparison step. The finite-field exactness and constructibility arguments are reproved privately from the local tensor model, since the packaged theorem imports a projection formula depending on this item.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarResidueLayer_constructible
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (r s : ℤ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (h₁ : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E 1 (by omega) Y
      ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)))
    (hbound : ∀ i : ℤ,
      i ∈ proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
        ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) →
      r ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s) (n : ℕ)
    (F : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → Submodule
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1)))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))))
    (hF : F = fun (j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) ↦ (Ideal.span ({ULift.up ((Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l L (n + 1)))
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l L))} :
          Set (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))))) ^ ((j : ℕ))) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1) (by omega)
    let B := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))
    ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)) (i : ℤ),
      IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf Y B
        ((filteredCoefficientTensorComplex Y B
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
          (integralScalarRho l E L ι Y n) P.obj
          (ModuleCat.of B ((F j.castSucc) ⧸
            (F j.succ).comap (F j.castSucc).subtype))).homology i)
